events.label: June PPI (8:30 AM ET) · Warsh Senate Banking testimony · ASML Q2 BEAT: guidance raised to €43-45B ✓
events.note: ASML Q2 2026 confirmed pre-open: €9.33B revenue (beat by €400M), EPS €7.59 (+€0.60 vs est.); full-year guidance raised to €43-45B from €36-40B — strongest AI capex print in months; stock +3.5% premarket. Goldman Sachs Q2: EPS $20.98 vs $14.48 est (best quarter in firm history, +9%); JPM profits +41% YoY. June PPI (8:30 AM ET) is today's HOLD→BUY verdict gate: consensus -0.1% MoM vs May +1.1%. Warsh Senate Banking (10 AM ET) is Day 2 of Humphrey-Hawkins. VIX ~14.4 post-CPI (below 15 BUY threshold). WTI $79.70 at the $80 September hike trip wire; naval blockade of Iranian ports active. BTC $64,630 Gate 2 cleared.

events.label: TSMC Q2 2026 earnings (2:00 PM ET) — AI capex cycle verdict; Retail Sales; Netflix Q2
events.note: TSMC Q2 2026 is the most important print of the week. June revenue +67.9% YoY is the backdrop; H2 AI datacenter guidance is the clearing event for NVDA ($210-215 entry zone), AMD, and AVGO positioning. Wall Street treating this as a health check for the entire AI boom. Stock testing $420 support pre-earnings; options pricing ~4% move. Retail sales (8:30 AM ET) adds macro context for consumer health. Netflix Q2 is a streaming/AI content signal.

events.label: TSLA Q2 2026 earnings (est.) + IBM full Q2 earnings call — dual clearing events
events.note: TSLA: Q2 earnings follow the blowout July 2 delivery report (480K vs 406K consensus). Need gross margin recovery (>25%), FSD revenue recognition at scale, Q3 delivery guide >450K for re-rate above $420. IBM: full Q2 call gives context on the software-to-hardware budget rotation that caused IBM's -25% worst day on record July 14. CEO attributed miss to clients redirecting software/consulting budgets to AI hardware (servers, storage, memory). If structural, enterprise software (ServiceNow, Salesforce, Accenture) faces multi-quarter headwinds.

events.label: FOMC meeting (Jul 28-29) — July hike probability now ~20%; no-hike expected; September language is the signal
events.note: June CPI undershoot (-0.4% MoM / 3.5% YoY) collapsed July hike probability from 40%+ to ~20% on July 14. No July hike now the strong base case. The FOMC statement language on September and the 2026 dot-plot update will be the market signal. If dots shift September hike lower: BUY upgrade likely. If dots maintain September hike risk: 30Y re-accelerates. Warsh's two Congressional testimonies (July 14-15) set the backdrop for no escalation.

events.label: META Q2 2026 earnings — AI cloud business first quantification; peak Q2 earnings week (GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN also)
events.note: META Q2 earnings July 29 is the first event where management must quantify the AI cloud business (Bloomberg July 1: Meta building AI cloud to sell excess compute). GOOGL, MSFT, and AMZN also report in late July — peak Q2 earnings risk window. IBM's enterprise software warning (July 14) adds a risk factor: MSFT Azure consulting and enterprise software could face read-across pressure. META's ad-driven model is insulated from IBM's enterprise IT budget rotation.

events.label: July CPI release (est. Aug 13) — captures WTI +9.4% spike (Jul 13) + Iran Hormuz blockade oil pass-through
events.note: June CPI (July 14) captured pre-Hormuz-shock prices and printed -0.4% MoM / 3.5% YoY. July CPI will be the FIRST month to reflect the WTI +9.4% spike of July 13 and the ongoing Strait disruption. If the Hormuz blockade persists through late July, July CPI could surprise significantly to the upside relative to June — erasing the July 14 disinflation narrative. This is the real inflation inflection event for H2 2026. The 30Y's failure to rally meaningfully on July 14 (only -0.4bps) suggests the bond market is already pricing this risk.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — $91B revenue guide; AI capex cycle fundamental clearing event
events.note: NVDA's Q2 FY27 earnings is the fundamental clearing event for the AI capex thesis. $91B revenue guidance represents sequential acceleration. IBM's July 14 warning (clients shifting software/consulting budgets to AI hardware) is a demand tailwind. TSMC Q2 (July 16) is the intermediate gate. Full-size add gate for NVDA: two consecutive closes above $215 + VIX <16 + TSMC Thursday confirming H2 AI capex.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as a public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since June 12 IPO. SPCX Nasdaq-100 effective July 7; inclusion-day distribution confirmed at $158.77 peak. Re-entry gate: two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. First earnings (Starlink subscriber/ARR growth, Starship launch cadence, cash burn) is the fundamental clearing event after the inclusion-day distribution pattern. Lock-up expiry December 9 adds supply overhang.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut, early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs. The $20B bond offering (June 22) already changed the capital structure risk profile — the lock-up expiry adds equity supply overhang.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). SoftBank sold off -13% on the delay. Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. The delay removes a near-term AI sentiment catalyst and adds uncertainty to AI infrastructure spending trajectories.
